outcome: Development pattern of Q-CPR and Q-UCR
Gestational age-specific reference intervals for Q-CPR and Q-UCR
cohort: The study included 134 singleton, low-risk pregnancies.
finding: Indices of fetal brain sparing based on placental and cerebral volume blood flow (Q-CPR and Q-UCR) correlated poorly with conventional pulsatility index-based CPR and UCR, indicating they provide different physiological information.
